decimal.name: supplierScoreQiWeight
decimal.title: Open quality improvement weight
decimal.help: Weight of the open quality improvement rate in the supplier score. A weight of 0 excludes the indicator from the score. The indicator is ignored when the Quality app is not installed.

boolean.name: autoComputeSupplierOpenQiRate
boolean.title: Compute open quality improvement rate automatically
boolean.help: When disabled, the open quality improvement rate is entered manually on the partner form and is never overwritten by the automatic computation.

decimal.name: supplierScoreNonConformityWeight
decimal.title: Non-conformity weight
decimal.help: Weight of the gravity-weighted non-conformity rate in the supplier score. A weight of 0 excludes the indicator from the score. The indicator is ignored when the Quality app is not installed.

boolean.name: autoComputeSupplierNonConformityRate
boolean.title: Compute non-conformity rate automatically
boolean.help: When disabled, the gravity-weighted non-conformity rate is entered manually on the partner form and is never overwritten by the automatic computation.

decimal.name: supplierScoreGravityCriticalWeight
decimal.title: Critical
decimal.help: Number of non-conformities a critical quality improvement counts for in the gravity-weighted non-conformity rate.

decimal.name: supplierScoreGravityMajorWeight
decimal.title: Major
decimal.help: Number of non-conformities a major quality improvement counts for in the gravity-weighted non-conformity rate. A quality improvement without gravity counts as major.

decimal.name: supplierScoreGravityMinorWeight
decimal.title: Minor
decimal.help: Number of non-conformities a minor quality improvement counts for in the gravity-weighted non-conformity rate.

integer.name: supplierQualityTrendMonths
integer.title: Quality trend period (months)
integer.help: Number of months between the current quality score and the monthly snapshot it is compared with to determine the quality trend of a supplier.

decimal.name: supplierQualityTrendTolerance
decimal.title: Quality trend tolerance (points)
decimal.help: Variation of the quality score, in points on the 0-100 scale, under which the quality trend of a supplier is considered stable.
